body:
## Goal
Make PM communication, assignment, agent progress, clarification and result one clear flow with responsive history and reachable input.

## Acceptance
A1. Complete PM message -> held brief -> one assignment -> worker -> clarification -> answer -> reviewer -> result in the originating chat. Task activity is optional; native/board receipts, not timers, establish state.
A2. New chat explains project and first Send; continuing an existing PM is direct. Preserve rename, files, history, New from draft, watch, archive/delete/Undo, detach/return, ownership and independent drafts.
A3. Use one reading viewport per thread and a naturally growing shared composer with no manual grip or inner text scroll. Keep Send reachable on long drafts; transcript content never shrinks/overlaps the composer.
A4. Reuse bounded native history with stable generation/cursor identities. Prepend/append/reflow/switch/reopen preserve record/offset; wheel-up pauses follow and only Latest resumes it. Preserve selection/copy/focus.
A5. Working workers accept a board-steer message before any question, using existing revision/attempt and one-writer boundaries. Ask uses current fluent answer semantics; retain #1817 files and #1818/#1785 race handling.
A6. Separate delivery from activity/outcome. Slow means elapsed only; unknown retains draft/files and checks the same operation, never auto-resends. Ended/reviewer/unsupported attempts explain limits and preserve input.
A7. Integrate #1918 append-only question/answer history and grouped tool steps. Remove duplicate identity/status text, not real history/evidence. No new task DB, gateway, scheduler, native writer or runtime fallback.
A8. Pass UX30-11..16, all eight daily journeys, Q-A1..Q-A12 and Claude adverse cases. Requalify existing #1741/#1742 behavior rather than replacing it; measure responsiveness and bound DOM/cache/IPC.

## Scope
- References: live-polish current task/agent preview plus baseline-v7 PM journey, preservation audit, input/scroll review and full Claude dispositions.
- Respect current main and #1918; the old mock is not authority to restore retired answer confirmations, attachment caps or flattened tool history.
- Use explicit disposable test sessions for native send proof after task release; never send an answer to a real owner task for a screenshot.

Depends on #1928
Depends on #1918

## Oct 30 review packet
[Complete prototype, plan, preservation audit, scenarios and Claude review](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34184601/taskq-ui-polish-handoff-2026-10-30-v2.zip)

Read `README.md`, `handoff/plan.md`, `handoff/acceptance.md` and `handoff/issues.json`; inspect `index.html`.
Coordinator: #1924. Dependencies: #1928, #1918.

Preserve current main and later accepted decisions. These source snapshots are proposed deltas, not replacement files.
All tasks were filed Held. Filing does not authorize task start, a PM message, deployment, service or permission changes.
